import Mathlib

open Int

theorem putnam_2018_a1
  (a b : ℤ)
  (h : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b) :
  ((1 : ℚ) / a + (1 : ℚ) / b = (3 : ℚ) / 2018) ↔
    (⟨a, b⟩ ∈ ({(673, 1358114), (674, 340033), (1009, 2018),
      (2018, 1009), (340033, 674), (1358114, 673)} : Set (ℤ × ℤ))) := by
  constructor
  · intro h_eq
    -- clear denominators
    have ha_ne : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt h.1)
    have hb_ne : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt h.2)
    have h_eq' := h_eq
    field_simp [ha_ne, hb_ne] at h_eq'
    -- obtain integer equation
    have h_int : (2018 : ℤ) * (a + b) = 3 * a * b := by
      have := h_eq'
      norm_cast at this
      exact this
    -- factorisation
    have h_fact : (3 * a - 2018) * (3 * b - 2018) = (2018 : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        (3 * a - 2018) * (3 * b - 2018)
            = 9 * a * b - 3 * 2018 * a - 3 * 2018 * b + (2018 : ℤ) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = 0 + (2018 : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
          have : 9 * a * b - 3 * 2018 * a - 3 * 2018 * b = 0 := by
            calc
              9 * a * b - 3 * 2018 * a - 3 * 2018 * b
                  = 3 * (3 * a * b - 2018 * a - 2018 * b) := by ring
              _ = 3 * ((2018 : ℤ) * (a + b) - 2018 * a - 2018 * b) := by
                simpa [h_int] using rfl
              _ = 0 := by ring
          simpa [this]

    have hpos_a : 0 < 3 * a - 2018 := by
      have : (1 : ℚ) / a ≤ (3 : ℚ) / 2018 := by
        have hbpos : (0 : ℚ) < (1 : ℚ) / b := by
          have : (0 : ℚ) < b := by exact_mod_cast h.2
          exact inv_pos.2 this
        have := h_eq
        linarith
      have ha_pos : (0 : ℚ) < a := by exact_mod_cast h.1
      have : (2018 : ℚ) ≤ 3 * a := by
        have : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (3 : ℚ) / 2018 * a := (div_le_iff ha_pos).mp this
        have : (2018 : ℚ) ≤ 3 * a := by
          have : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (3 : ℚ) / 2018 * a := this
          have : (2018 : ℚ) ≤ 3 * a := by
            have : (2018 : ℚ) * (1 : ℚ) ≤ (2018 : ℚ) * ((3 : ℚ) / 2018 * a) := by
              have : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (2018 : ℚ) := by norm_num
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by norm_num)
            simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, div_mul_eq_mul_div] using this
          exact this
        exact this
      have : (0 : ℤ) < 3 * a - 2018 := by
        have : (2018 : ℤ) ≤ 3 * a := by exact_mod_cast this
        linarith
      exact this
    have hpos_b : 0 < 3 * b - 2018 := by
      have : (1 : ℚ) / b ≤ (3 : ℚ) / 2018 := by
        have ha_pos : (0 : ℚ) < (1 : ℚ) / a := by
          have : (0 : ℚ) < a := by exact_mod_cast h.1
          exact inv_pos.2 this
        have := h_eq
        linarith
      have hb_pos : (0 : ℚ) < b := by exact_mod_cast h.2
      have : (2018 : ℚ) ≤ 3 * b := by
        have : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (3 : ℚ) / 2018 * b := (div_le_iff hb_pos).mp this
        have : (2018 : ℚ) ≤ 3 * b := by
          have : (2018 : ℚ) * (1 : ℚ) ≤ (2018 : ℚ) * ((3 : ℚ) / 2018 * b) := by
            have : (0 : ℚ) ≤ (2018 : ℚ) := by norm_num
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by norm_num)
          simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, div_mul_eq_mul_div] using this
        exact this
      have : (0 : ℤ) < 3 * b - 2018 := by
        have : (2018 : ℤ) ≤ 3 * b := by exact_mod_cast this
        linarith
      exact this
    -- divisor condition
    have h_dvd : (3 * a - 2018) ∣ (2018 : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
      have : (3 * a - 2018) * (3 * b - 2018) = (2018 : ℤ) ^ 2 := h_fact
      exact dvd_of_mul_left_dvd this
    have h_mod : (3 * a - 2018) % 3 = 1 % 3 := by
      have : (3 * a - 2018) ≡ -2018 [ZMOD 3] := by
        simpa [Int.mod_mul_left_mod] using (Int.mod_mul_left_mod (3 * a) 3)
      simpa [Int.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : 0 ≤ 2018 % 3),
            show (2018 % 3) = 2 by norm_num] using this

        (3 * a - 2018) = 1 ∨ (3 * a - 2018) = 4 ∨
        (3 * a - 2018) = 1009 ∨ (3 * a - 2018) = 4036 ∨
        (3 * a - 2018) = 1018081 ∨ (3 * a - 2018) = 4072324 := by
      have h_abs : (3 * a - 2018).natAbs ∈
          ({1, 4, 1009, 4036, 1018081, 4072324} : Finset ℕ) := by
        have h_dvd_nat : (3 * a - 2018).natAbs ∣ (2018 : ℕ) ^ 2 := by
          have : (3 * a - 2018) ∣ (2018 : ℤ) ^ 2 := h_dvd
          exact (Int.coe_natAbs_dvd_iff).mpr this

          have : (3 * a - 2018) % 3 = 1 % 3 := h_mod

          · simpa using h_mod_nat
        have hlist :
            ({1, 4, 1009, 4036, 1018081, 4072324} : Finset ℕ) =
            (Finset.divisors (2018 ^ 2)).filter (fun n => n % 3 = 1) := by
          norm_num
        simpa [hlist] using this
      rcases (Finset.mem_insert).1 ((Finset.mem_insert).1
        ((Finset.mem_insert).1 ((Finset.mem_insert).1
          ((Finset.mem_insert).1 ((Finset.mem_singleton).1
            (by
              have : (3 * a - 2018) ∈ ({1, 4, 1009, 4036, 1018081, 4072324} : Finset ℤ) := by
                simpa using h_abs
              exact this)))) with
        h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inl h2
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inl h3
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inl h4
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inl h5
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inr <| Or.inr h6
    rcases h_cases with h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6
    · -- a = 673
